moments.author: Sridhar Vembu
moments.quote: India should ban social media for young children... read physical books, play in the dirt under the sun and stay away from social media!
moments.why: A viral post that ignited a fierce debate over social media’s impact on youth and parenting norms in tech and business circles.

moments.author: Adam Kinzinger
moments.why: A pithy and mocking reaction to a political speech that swiftly spread across social media, amplifying bipartisan snark.

moments.author: Unknown (quoted via PopBase)
moments.quote: "After hearing the gunshots… many people yelled 'Get down'… which caused Nicki Minaj to start twerking."
moments.why: A bizarre and racially charged joke by Donald Trump went viral for its shock value and surreal imagery.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Maybe some people do loathe me — and that’s probably true — I don’t care… they hate you far more than they hate me.
moments.why: Musk’s provocatively dismissive remark toward the media stirred conversation about his influence and media distrust.

moments.author: Sophie Cunningham
moments.quote: Biological men should not participate in women’s sports.
moments.why: Her controversial stance on transgender athletes went viral and was amplified by political figures, fueling heated culture‑war debate.
